claims.claim: Get 5 copies of good books for 20k & 10 copies for 33k
claims.evidence: Price and bundle terms are seller-stated; the report only shows a stack of 10 spines, not a confirmation of bundle/quantity options or that 'good' condition applies beyond the spine view.

claims.claim: Books are in good condition ('good books')
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows spines unbent and clean, but covers, corners, interior pages, and any water damage or odor are not shown.

claims.claim: Implied: all 10 titles listed form one complete lot for sale
claims.evidence: Report notes it is unclear whether all ten are sold as one lot or individually.

risks.risk: Interior page condition (yellowing, highlighting, missing pages, water stains)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of open interior pages for each book, especially title/copyright page and a mid-book spread.

risks.risk: Front/back cover and corner wear not visible from spine-only shots
risks.proof: Straight-on photos of front and back covers and all four corners of each book.

risks.risk: Possible counterfeit or pirated printing (common for popular business/self-help titles in this market)
risks.proof: Clear photo of publisher's imprint page, ISBN barcode, and print quality close-up.

risks.risk: Uncertainty whether full set of 10 is guaranteed or seller will substitute/split lot
risks.proof: A single photo or video showing all 10 books together with a count confirmation matching the listed titles.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming only partial/uncertain lot delivery

risks.risk: Odor, mold, or water damage not detectable from spine-only angle
risks.proof: Photo of book edges/pages fanned open to inspect for stains, plus seller statement on storage conditions treated as unverified.

proof_requests: Photos of front and back covers for each of the 10 books
Close-up of interior pages (title page and a few random pages) for each book
Photo of publisher/ISBN page to confirm authenticity
A single photo/video showing all books together with a count, confirming the lot is complete and sold as one set
Any additional angle showing edges/pages fanned for staining or odor signs
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a stack of 10 named paperback business/self-help books, so a worst-case price is possible despite unverified condition, authenticity, and lot-completeness claims.
